proves.claim: identifyCaller in a folder whose marker names a joined seat that no longer holds the item refuses NOT_JOINED naming the seat folder and the item number.

cli.io-read-seat-folder.names-seat.why: A seat that ran a command from its item folder after submit was told only to join a lane.

proves.claim: A worktree with no marker keeps its NOT_JOINED text, and an item folder whose seat still holds the claim still resolves the seat.

cli.io-read-seat-folder.plain-folder-unc.why: The hint must not change plain folders or live item folders.

proves.claim: The real status command in such a folder reads the seat path in its refusal.

cli.io-read-seat-folder.real-status.why: The refusal must reach the person through the real command, not only the function.
